title: LTX 2.5 — Run This Free Open Source AI Video Model On Your Own PC
description:
You no longer need to pay for closed AI video tools.

LTX 2.5 is a free, open source AI video model built by 
Lightricks — and you can run it directly on your own hardware.

LTX-2.5 is the only open source model with native audio-video 
generation in a single pass, plus multi-shot sequences that 
hold continuity across cuts.

Here's what makes it different 👇

✅ Multiple connected shots — characters, lighting and scenes 
stay consistent across the whole sequence
✅ New diffusion video decoder — sharper faces, clearer text, 
better motion
✅ Native audio-video generation — synchronized in one pass
✅ Run it locally — no per-generation fees, no cloud dependency
✅ Build on it — weights, code and fine-tuning tools all open

LTX models have passed 33 million downloads on Hugging Face — 
one of the clearest signals open source video AI has moved 
to production.

full local quality needs 32GB VRAM with FP8 
quantization — an RTX 5090 or A100 is recommended. 
A free LTX API key handles text encoding and is 
highly recommended to speed up inference.

----------------------------------------
🔔 Subscribe for daily free AI tools that actually work.
----------------------------------------
